faq.q: What is included in the Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks (tapas), insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Champagne is served as part of the drinks selection, and tapas are provided as light snacks.

faq.q: Which boats are available for the sunset cruise?
faq.a: We offer a range of yachts departing from Puerto Banús. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are popular at €749 for 2 hours. Larger groups can choose the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) from €4,719 for 4 hours. All boats include a skipper and drinks.

faq.q: How long does the sunset cruise last?
faq.a: Cruises are typically 2 to 4 hours, depending on your booking. The 2-hour option is perfect for a quick sunset experience, while 4 hours allows for more sailing and relaxation. Prices for Tier A boats start at €749 for 2 hours and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food or drinks?
faq.a: Our charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks (tapas). Champagne is also provided. You are welcome to bring additional food or drinks if you wish, but we recommend enjoying our included offerings for a hassle-free experience.

faq.q: What is the best time for a sunset cruise in Marbella?
faq.a: Sunset times in Marbella vary from around 18:00 in winter to 21:30 in summer. We recommend booking a 2-hour cruise starting 30-60 minutes before sunset to catch the golden hour over the Mediterranean. Contact us via WhatsApp for exact timing based on your date.

faq.q: Is the sunset cruise suitable for large groups or celebrations?
faq.a: Yes, our yachts can accommodate up to 12 passengers on boats like the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 Flybridge. The sunset cruise is ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, or corporate events. Champagne and tapas add a festive touch. Book early to secure your preferred yacht.

faq.q: How do I book the 2041 edition sunset cruise?
faq.a: You can book directly through our website or contact us via WhatsApp for pricing on specific yachts. For Tier A boats, prices start at €749 for 2 hours. For other boats like the Mangusta 80, pricing is on request. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: We monitor weather conditions closely. If a cruise is cancelled due to unsafe conditions, you will receive a full refund or the option to reschedule. Our licensed skipper will make the final call on the day of departure to ensure your safety.

data.body_html:
Experience a Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas in the 2041 edition—an evening of luxury on the Mediterranean. Departing from Puerto Banús, our fleet of yachts offers the perfect setting for a golden-hour sail with drinks and tapas. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on Tier A boats, including a skipper, fuel, and all refreshments. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply enjoying Marbella's coastline, this cruise combines elegance with relaxation.

Why Choose a Sunset Cruise with Champagne and Tapas?

A sunset cruise in Marbella is more than a boat ride—it's an experience. The warm evening light reflects off the Mediterranean, and the Sierra Blanca mountains provide a stunning backdrop. Champagne and tapas elevate the moment, making it ideal for couples, groups, or solo travellers. Our charters include a licensed skipper, so you can relax and enjoy the views without any concerns. The 2041 edition ensures modern comfort and style on every vessel.

Our Fleet for the Sunset Cruise

We offer a variety of yachts departing from Puerto Banús. For a classic sunset cruise, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 passengers) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 passengers) are excellent choices at €749 for 2 hours. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 passengers) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. All boats come with a skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks (tapas), insurance, and Spanish IVA. Champagne is served as part of the drinks selection.

What to Expect on the Cruise

Your sunset cruise begins at Puerto Banús. The skipper will guide you along the coast, past Marbella's Golden Mile and landmarks like La Concha mountain. You'll enjoy panoramic views of the Mediterranean as the sun sets. Onboard, you'll be served champagne and a selection of tapas—light snacks that complement the drinks. The yacht is equipped with safety gear and insurance, so you can focus on the experience. The cruise typically lasts 2 to 4 hours, depending on your booking.

Best Sunset Spots Along the Coast

From Puerto Banús, you can sail towards Cabopino or Estepona, both offering spectacular sunset views. Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés are secluded coves where the water reflects the evening colours. The skipper knows the best routes and will adjust based on weather and sunset timing. For a longer cruise, head towards Sotogrande or simply drift near the coast. The 2041 edition includes updated navigation for optimal sunset viewing.

Booking and Pricing for 2041

Prices for the sunset cruise start at €749 for 2 hours on Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39). For 8 hours, the price is €2,299. The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) costs €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, including a free jet ski. Other boats, like the Ferretti 94 or Maiora 26m, are priced on request—contact us via WhatsApp. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, tapas, insurance, and IVA. Book early as sunset slots are popular, especially in summer.
